text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On my way home from the Gold class
briefing
session, I spot a trainer's
notebook lying on the
road.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Glancing inside, I see it's filled with
detailed
information about the owner's
trainee.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not just their training schedule either,
but also
their love for aquariums, their
favorite restaurants
and several
associated recipes...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Good job, Meek. Let's finish here today.
choice_data_list: （もしかして、この持ち主って……）

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
All right...
Um...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Yes? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
About dinner... What do you... want to
eat?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Looking at your recent dietary
intake, it
seems a little lacking in fat.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Let's cook something up to fix that!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Um...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Oh! And I'll add in some of your
favourite foods,
of course.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Enjoying your food is just as important as

nutritional balance!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Now, you'd better change your clothes
before
you get cold. I'll join you soon.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer
<username>.
It's
nice to see you again.
choice_data_list: 桐生院トレーナー、お疲れ様です

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I heard through the grapevine that

<chrname> has reached Gold
class!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Actually, we just achieved the same
thing. Hehe,
I'm honored to reach such
an elite class at the
same time as you!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Even so, we still have a long way to go.
But don't
you worry—we're working
harder than ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If Happy Meek has also reached Gold
class,
Trainer Kiryuin must have been at
the briefing
session earlier.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And given the contents of this
notebook, there's
no mistake. I take out
the trainer's notebook and
show it to
her.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Ah... So that's where it went!
choice_data_list: このノート、見覚えありませんか？
choice_data_list_en: Does this notebook look familiar to you?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I couldn't find it after I got
back from
the briefing session, and I was
looking
everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I dropped it on the way
back from
an official meeting... How
embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I mention that I guessed it was hers
based on the
details inside.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... That's the advice you gave me in
action.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Every time I learn more about Meek, I'm
so happy
that I end up writing pages and
pages.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: It's just...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, nothing! Ahaha, nothing to
see here.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Right, training's over! Time to clean up!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
See you around,
Trainer
<username>.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With how abruptly Trainer Kiryuin bails
on the
conversation, it's hard not to feel
concerned.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I just don't get it.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Why is Meek making so little progress?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
There shouldn't be any problems with
her training
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
The previous generations of the Kiryuin
family all
achieved results by following
the directions in the
Trainer's Handbook.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume trained using this handbook
have
gone on to win G1 races and
receive countless
accolades... It's the
accumulation of generations
of wisdom.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
And Meek isn't falling short, either in
motivation
or ability.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: So the weak link must be...
